learning: Iterations 9 and 10 gave identical results (52.1441), so the geometry and controller are repeatable. The slalom max_error (0.0676) is the margin to watch. If noise_robustness is low on the development tracks, the unseen track is at higher risk of drift, and the fallback is wheel_radius 0.04 m.
notes: Final package: the confirmed best geometry (wheel_radius 0.044 m) with the controller that gave identical results in iterations 9 and 10. The controller is unchanged so the race checks margin for the unseen track, not a new gain.
rationale: Iteration 10 reproduced iteration 9 exactly (score 52.1441), so the design is repeatable across the development tracks. Its slalom max_error of 0.0676 is the tightest margin, but it is under the 0.069 band. The only change I considered, a gain or base_speed change, has no evidence behind it. Gains (kp 2.5 to 3.0, ki 0.05 to 0.3, kd 0.05 to 0.1) moved max_error by under 0.007 m in every test, and base_speed was never varied. An untested controller change in the final iteration could push the slalom past the band without any way to check it. I therefore keep the Builder's geometry (wheel_radius 0.044 m, all else unchanged) and the iteration 9 and 10 controller unchanged. The only addition is measurement requests for noise_robustness and controller_errors, which are needed to judge the unseen final track. Expected result: s-bend progress about 0.160 with max_error about 0.062, slalom progress about 0.110 with max_error about 0.068, oval progress about 0.110.
